name: survey-method-selection
description: Validates survey method selection UI: clicking through seismic, core_sample, and aerial methods highlights the selected method and updates the cost/accuracy display. Each method triggers the correct console command.

steps.description: Test-only bootstrap, not a player action: hiring already grants the Rookie starting qualification (ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION in Employee.ts, same for the UI hire button and this console command), so this only raises the level for the scenario's needs. No role tag -- there is no UI control for this and none should exist; the player-facing way to raise a skill is `employee train` at a training building. Command mode keeps running it unchanged; interaction mode keeps it as an unmarked (legacy) command step.

event choose 0 -- follows a bare tick, so whether an event is pending is a random roll; there may be no dialog on screen. Deliberately left unmarked: a player step must name a control that is actually there, and forcing a click here would fail on the roll rather than on a defect.
